title: NASNet
description: Documented public neural architecture search (Google (Zoph et al.)) for the Model Architecture Search Engine capability area.
body:
NASNet is a documented neural architecture search from Google (Zoph et al.). The landmark 2017 neural architecture search result: a controller RNN discovering cell structures beating hand-designed ImageNet models.

How it works: It works by sampling random architectures from the search space, scoring each with a cheap proxy, and returning the top candidates.

Documented uses of this capability area include neural architecture search, automated hyperparameter tuning, model evaluation leaderboards, and AI safety red-teaming.
